verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of page-count limits, file-size limits, chunking, or guarantees against timeouts or truncation for very large inputs. The only large-document evidence is a hands-on report that a 900-page job timed out through the API and had to be split manually. The listed /v1/batch endpoint covers request batching, not reliable handling of a single huge file, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data engineer, thousand-page documents and multi-gigabyte files process reliably without timeouts or silent truncation
